subject.title: Control UI: Memory panel for MEMORY.md and USER.md

question: Should OpenClaw expose browser read/write access for USER.md, MEMORY.md, and daily memory notes in core Control UI now, or should that wait for a broader plugin/contribution-slot boundary?
rationale: The request is useful but changes the browser-accessible surface for sensitive memory and prompt-state files, and current main intentionally separates allowlisted root-file edits from read-only workspace browsing.

options.title: Keep as product/security review
options.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers decide the core-vs-plugin UI boundary and the scoped memory-note write contract.

options.title: Implement narrow core panel
options.body: Approve a memory-specific core UI over USER.md, MEMORY.md, and validated daily notes with focused gateway and UI tests.

options.title: Defer to plugin slots
options.body: Wait for Control UI contribution slots so a memory plugin can provide this panel without expanding core UI ownership.

recommendation.title: Keep as product/security review
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers decide the core-vs-plugin UI boundary and the scoped memory-note write contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The current read-only workspace browsing contract and related security boundary were introduced in recent work by this owner.
